blurb: A: At North Lake Resort, the annual cost for a seasonal campsite which hasn't risen since opening is $2,500 Plus HST. This fee covers site rental for the full season, providing your family with a reliable and comfortable space to enjoy throughout the camping months. Additionally it covers both power and water, weekly black & gray water disposal, garbage disposal, firewood, docking etc.
